# mycelium

> Persistent memory for LLM CLIs that behaves like a brain, not a database.

Machine-readable map for agents. Read `agent-index.json` first to jump
straight to a file span instead of crawling; see `AGENTS.md` for the protocol.

## Bootstrap
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how agents should work in this repo; read first.
- [agent-index.json](agent-index.json): concepts, components and tools mapped to file paths and line spans.
- [agent-graph.json](agent-graph.json): full structural graph (every symbol, import and call edge).

## MCP tools
- `connections` (mycelium/server.py:1923-1940): Show all connections for a specific memory - the local network topology.
- `consolidate` (mycelium/server.py:1656-1706): Show memories ready for consolidation.
- `context` (mycelium/server.py:1303-1392): Load startup context - the hubs of your memory network.
- `discover` (mycelium/server.py:1711-1838): Discover hidden connections in the memory network.
- `forget` (mycelium/server.py:1843-1868): Delete a memory and all its connections.
- `maintain` (mycelium/server.py:1893-1918): Periodic memory consolidation - snapshot, plan, cold-mark, orphan rescue.
- `pin` (mycelium/server.py:1873-1888): Pin or unpin a memory. Pinned memories' connections never decay below the
- `recall` (mycelium/server.py:1109-1298): Search memories and propagate through connections.
- `recent` (mycelium/server.py:1485-1524): Recent episodic digest - what's been worked on lately, newest first.
- `resolve` (mycelium/server.py:1068-1104): Create a disambiguation memory for an ambiguous term.
- `review` (mycelium/server.py:1563-1615): Review the health of the memory network.
- `save` (mycelium/server.py:940-1063): Save a memory. Keep it short and dense - one idea per memory.

## Components
- `comp.substrate`: Storage, config, FTS and formatting that every tool composes.
- `comp.config`: TOML + env config loading, search paths, defaults.
- `comp.semantic`: Embedding client and vector search; embed-on-save, semantic recall.
- `comp.graph_dynamics`: Decay, co-access strengthening, neighbor walk: the neural mechanics.
- `comp.write_path`: save / resolve / pin: dedup, embed, connect, protect.
- `comp.read_path`: recall / context / connections: FTS+semantic fusion, propagation.
- `comp.episodic`: recent(): time-ordered digest of what was just worked on.
- `comp.maintenance`: consolidate/forget/review/maintain: snapshot, cold-mark, protect, rescue.
- `comp.discover`: Find hidden connections and rescue orphan memories.
- `comp.foundry`: Append-only decision log; queryable for pattern analysis. Separable.
- `comp.dashboard`: Read-only web viewer of the memory graph. Stdlib http.server.
- `comp.cli`: Entrypoint: serve/init/config/dash/backfill-vectors/maintain/foundry.
- `comp.evaluate`: Recall benchmark harness (paraphrase recall@k).
